title: Digital Plant Manager
text:
Some people manage teams. Others build environments where elite technical talent thrives, innovation accelerates, and customers become lifelong advocates. We’re looking for a Digital Plant Manager who can do all three.

This isn’t a “keep the trains running” management role. We need a leader who can build and steward high-performing Agile teams, drive operational excellence, own financial outcomes, and help shape the future of Vertech’s Digital Plant organization. You’ll lead self-organizing Scrum teams delivering world class industrial automation and software solutions while guiding strategic investments in internal development tools and accelerators that improve how we work and scale.

If you know how to balance leadership with accountability, coaching with execution, and strategy with action—and you genuinely enjoy helping talented people do the best work of their careers—we should probably talk.

**Who We Are**

At Vertech, not only do we develop world class industrial automation solutions for some of the top US companies, we also strive to be the team of choice for the best and brightest talent. I mean, we call ourselves control freaks for a reason.

The passion (and intelligence) our employees have is truly mind-blowing. In turn, we work hard to take care of our own with excellent benefits and pay, personal development, and transparent communication. We also know that you can be great at what you do and still have fun.

If that sounds like a good fit, help us bring the next generation of automation solutions to industries including data centers, renewable energy, manufacturing, food and beverage, water and wastewater, and more.

**Top Reasons to Work with Us**

* Flexible work schedule with work from home options for many roles
* Weekly communication from management in our internally famous Friday morning meeting
* Competitive compensation including a bonus plan
* No more than a 4 week waiting period on all benefits including the 401k
* A really rad Christmas Party each year
* A manager that is cool…most of the time, because no one is perfect
* A path for growth, a great culture, PTO, AND MORE!

**What You Will Be Doing**

* Build, lead, and develop high-performing Professional Scrum teams capable of delivering world class customer outcomes
* Coach, mentor, and support team members through consistent feedback, career development, and leadership
* Ensure teams are staffed with the right people in the right roles while fostering Vertech’s culture and core values
* Own the financial performance and delivery outcomes of projects executed by your teams
* Serve as the primary escalation point for customers beyond the execution team
* Drive operational excellence using Professional Agile Leadership (PAL-E), Scrum principles, and Evidence Based Management (EBM)
* Govern and prioritize Digital Plant’s portfolio of internal software accelerators and development tools
* Partner with leadership to contribute to strategic planning and organizational growth initiatives
* Ensure investment initiatives are properly staffed, organized, funded, and aligned with company objectives
* Promote continuous improvement in delivery execution, technical excellence, and team collaboration
* Work closely with HR and leadership on hiring, onboarding, employee growth, and team performance
* Help create an environment where highly technical people genuinely enjoy coming to work

**What You Need for this Position**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related technical field (or equivalent industry experience)
* Deep expertise in Agile frameworks, Professional Scrum, and Professional Agile Leadership (PAL-E)
* 7+ years of experience in industrial automation and systems integration
* 3+ years of leadership experience with accountability for team success
* Strong understanding of software and industrial systems development methodologies including Agile, DevOps, CI/CD, and related practices
* Proven ability to lead technical teams while balancing customer satisfaction, delivery quality, and financial performance
* Excellent communication, organizational, and leadership skills
* Strong business acumen including understanding of project financials, margins, utilization, and operational efficiency

**Bonus Points If You Have**

* Experience leading multiple Scrum teams simultaneously
* Background in software product or platform development
* Experience scaling Agile delivery organizations
* Passion for coaching and developing technical talent
* A desire to build systems and teams that continuously improve over time

**Why This Role Matters**

The Digital Plant Manager plays a critical role in Vertech’s vision to be recognized as a world class provider of industrial automation services—and the employer of choice for top talent. This role directly influences our people, our customers, our delivery capabilities, and the future of how we scale Digital Plant operations.

No pressure. But also…kind of a big deal.
